_README: Every human judgement about this ROM lives in this file; the
generated listings are disposable, so renaming is free.
What to do next, roughly in order:
Read the coverage it reports. Low coverage is normal at
first and is the number you are trying to move.
2. Every unresolved indirect jump it reports is a hole. Add the
target to `entries`, or the pointer pair to `ram_vectors` if
the handler is installed into RAM.
Finds the sound code and the tables feeding it.
4. Name things in `labels` as soon as you know what they are.
See docs/method.md for the working order and docs/pitfalls.md for
the traps that each cost real time.

headers.b0:B000: The shop. In: A = bonus (BCD, hundreds), Y = 0, X = flags. Builds the screen from ROM templates, then loops at Shop_Frame until QUIT.
headers.b0:B679: Hover: which item is under the cursor. Rows 0-5 use the RAM map shop_shelf_hover_map (6 rows x 28 cells of 4 pixels); rows 19+ with x < $50 use the car map through the pointers at $9A15.
headers.b0:9F4D: QUIT: commit the working copy (condition, counts, types, money) to the game's own state.
headers.f6:56B6: Switches bank 4 in for the text panel's font (CHARBASE $B0), runs the sound tick and the password line, then waits INSIDE the interrupt until the next DLI (ShopDLI_5) sets $72, and switches bank 0 back.
headers.b4:A3EA: The HUD ticker: every 4th frame the 18-character row at $2472 moves left one character and the next letter of the current word enters at $2484.

blocks.note: 19 pointers to lists of four type-name pointers
19 prices, BCD low byte then high byte
19 repair prices, BCD low then high
ticker messages: word offsets into Ticker_Words, zero ends a message
14 password words and PASSWORD, 8 tile codes each

notes.f7:
fatalrun.a78
mapper supergame, 128 KB, NTSC
no POKEY declared; audio is the TIA's two voices

Vectors: IRQ $D000  NMI $FD1F  RESET $D000

Written by init.py. Everything here is read from the cartridge; the
judgement calls are yours to add.
notes.b0: Bank 0: the shop (code $B000-$BFFF and $9000-$9059, $9F4D; data $8AF0-$9FFF; shelf graphics $8000-$8AFF).
notes.b4: Bank 4: title, password entry, high scores, HUD ticker, sound tick ($A003/$A006), the 4-pixel text font at $B000-$B7FF.
